title: pcapng: put the Netflix custom stuff into a separate header file.
description:
Stuff about custom blocks and options doesn't belong in core Wireshark
headers, as that won't scale, and won't even *work* for plugins.  Put it
into a separate wiretap/pcapng-netflix-custom.h file, and make the old
wiretap/pcapng-netflix-custom.h file, which declared functions to handle
those blocks and options, into wiretap/pcapng-netflix-custom-int.h, as
that's all temporary, pending the introduction of a general mechanism to
register pcapng modules to handle custom blocks and options.
